invariants.rationale: As the method returns 'result' as type Dialog, it's expected to be non-null.
A valid TextButton requires a non-null style, so 'buttonStyle' is likely non-null.
The returned object must be a Dialog, so this type relationship always holds.
The result is typically 'this', but may be delegated or always non-null.
If 'text' is not null, it could be non-empty or empty; this covers both.
